name: Vvveb
description: Powerful and easy to use cms to build websites, blogs or ecommerce stores.
composeYaml:
services:
  vvveb:
    image: 'vvveb/vvvebcms:latest'
    volumes:
      - 'vvveb-data:/var/www/html'
    environment:
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10
